# Fortune Studio LLC

> Fortune Studio LLC is a photography studio and event-rental company in Scranton, Pennsylvania, USA. We offer professional portrait photography sessions and table & chair rentals for birthdays, weddings, baby showers, graduations and other events.

## Services
- Portrait photography sessions (30 to 120 minutes), starting from $99
- Table and chair rentals, with optional delivery and pickup
- Party and celebration packages
- Studio space rental by the hour
- Wedding and event photo/video coverage (deposit to hold the date, final price quoted)

## Booking and contact

- Languages on the website: English, Spanish, French
